name: Conflagration
description: Burn and Shock you apply last +1 turn. Burn already stacks on a target (up to three, each stack a full tick), which covers the stacking.

effects.note: `status` the holder applies lasts +amount turns (one line per status)

mastery.text: Stack three times: Burn’s own record already allows three stacks (03 §3.5), so the Mastery adds nothing further.
